scope: This RCIP implementation completed its local source, producer, generated native consumer and dependency-graph validation. The known upstream compiler failure, earlier attempts, historical mainline evidence and outstanding current-PR platform acceptance remain separate.

source.binding: This candidate identifies the implementation before the validation documentation update. The canonical changed-implementation manifest below remains comparable across documentation-only commits; this file does not claim its own future commit was executed.

implementationManifest.fileContentHash: SHA-256 of the exact working-tree file bytes, verified to have no implementation diff from candidateRevision; deleted files use null.
implementationManifest.exclusionRule: Exclude any basename README.md, CONTROL-MIGRATION.md, RCIP-*.md, or VALIDATION-*; include changed implementation, tests, manifests, lockfile, compiler pin, generated code and receipts.
implementationManifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON of the files array with files sorted by path, object keys sorted lexicographically, ensure_ascii=false, and separators comma/colon with no whitespace or trailing newline.

remainingScope: Current-PR CI still needs its clean headless base-image and native data-source mutation lanes, cross-platform packages and packaged X11/Wayland input acceptance; consult the live PR checks.
Upstream PR #1791 remains subject to its independent GitHub review and repository integration rules. Local agent review is not a GitHub approval.

Remaining host adoption gaps are enumerated in RCIP-2026-11-24.md, including master insert bypass, selectable command adapters, and checked-menu selection propagation.
limitations: Runtime, producer, native framework tests, SDK tests, graph rules and OS input runs prove different layers; their counts are not summed into a single acceptance total.
The canonical implementation digest binds changed implementation bytes only; documentation changes do not imply a new runtime execution.
Earlier failures, stale-binary executions and infrastructure errors are retained rather than recast as passes.
No current candidate visual, physical touch, system IME, screen-reader, Windows/macOS native-window or packaged X11/Wayland success is asserted here.
